paite: Aw, Israel suante aw, Aigupta gam a kipan a ka hon pikhiak inkote aw, TOUPA'N hichibang a nou ahon demna thu ngaikhia un,
heading: Israelte Thuhilhna

paite: "Noute kia leitung a inkuan tengteng a ka theih na hi ua; huaiziak in na thulimlouhna tengteng uah ka hon gawt ding," achi hi.
Akithukim kei un mi nih apai-khawm ding ua hia?
heading: Zawlnei Nasep

paite: Humpinelkai in gammang a sa amat lai louh ngal in, ahumham ngei a hia? Humpinelkai lun lai in bangmah amat keileh akohawm sung a kipan ahumham ngei a hia?
Amah a dia tah a-om keileh, leitung a thang ah vasa a-awk thei a hia? Thang pen bangmah awk lou in lei a kipan in akisai dia hia?
Khopi ah mi launa lou ah pengkul amut ding ua hia? TOUPA hih louh in khopi ah hoihlouhna ahong om dia hia?
Diktak in Toupa PATHIAN in anasemmi, azawlneite kiang ah athuguk hilh lou in bangmah ahih kei ding hi.
Humpinelkai ahumham a, kua ahia lau lou ding? Toupa PATHIAN in thu agen a, kua'n ahia gen lou thei ding?
Ashdod kumpipa' inn te leh Aigupta gam kumpipa' inn te ah gen unla, "Samaria tang tungte ah kikhawm unla, huai a buaina liantak omte leh huai lak a simmohna omte en un," chi in.
heading: Samaria Tunggikna

paite: "Akumpipa uh innte a hiamgamna leh kisuamna koihkhawm mite'n lah hihdik dan asiam ngal kei ua," TOUPA'N achi.
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Gam kimvel in melma a-om lai ding a; na kiang a kipan na hatna alakhe ding a, na kumpipa' inn te ahihse ding uhi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Belampu in humpinelkai kam a kipan akhe nih hiam, bil them hiam, ahonkhia bang in, huchibang in Samaria a teng Israelte lupna ning leh lupna maimom puanphan lukham them toh hutkhiak in a-om ding uhi.
Ngai unla, Jakob inkote tung ah theisak un,"

"Israel tatleknate amah tung ah ka gawtleh, huai ni chiang in, Bethel a maitamte leng ka gawt ngal dia; maitam kiite tankhiak in a-om ding ua, lei ah ake ding uh," sepaihte Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
"Huan phalbi leh nipi inn ka satse ding a; saiha innte amangthang ding a, inn thupite'n tawpna anei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
